title: Backups
subtitle: Is the database being backed up, and when was the last good copy taken? Backups are written to a folder on the server; there is no download here on purpose.
loadFailed: The backup status could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

off.title: Automatic backups are off
off.text: No nightly backup is taken until the setting "Backup.Enabled" is switched on. You can still back up by hand below.

status.title: Backup status

stateText.ok: The last verified backup is recent.
stateText.old: The last verified backup is more than 26 hours old, so a night was missed. Check the runs below.
stateText.never: No verified backup exists yet. Until one does, nothing can be restored.
stateText.manual: Automatic backups are off, so there is no schedule to be late for. The last verified backup is shown below.

status.freeUnknown: Not available (for example a network path)
status.nextNone: Not scheduled (automatic backups are off or the nightly worker is switched off)

notes.title: What this does not do
notes.disk: A backup kept on the same disk as the database is not disaster recovery. If the disk, the machine or the site is lost, both are lost. Copy the backup folder to another machine or to cloud storage every night.
notes.encryption: The backup files are not encrypted. Anyone who can read the folder can read every customer's data. Keep the folder locked down.
notes.uploads: The uploads folder (product pictures, return photos, ticket attachments) is not inside the database backup. It needs its own copy.
notes.restore: Restoring is done by an operator with the scripts scripts/restore-db.ps1 (restore) and scripts/restore-test.ps1 (check a backup on a throw-away copy). There is no restore button on purpose.

run.confirmText: A verified backup is written to the configured folder on the server. It can take a while, and the page keeps showing its progress. Only one backup can run at a time.
run.runningText: Started {time}. This page refreshes every 15 seconds until it finishes.
run.already: A backup is already running. This page will show it when it finishes.

runs.title: Backup runs
runs.emptyDescription: Runs appear here when a backup is taken, by hand or by the nightly schedule.
runs.loadFailed: The list of backup runs could not be loaded.

inventory.title: What the system holds
inventory.subtitle: A snapshot of how much the system stores. Counts only: no personal data is shown. Archived rows and every branch are included.
inventory.loadFailed: The data inventory could not be loaded.
inventory.uploadsTruncated: Counting stopped at {files} files; the real size is larger.
